titulo_original: Da je kuća dobra i vuk bi je imao

sinopsis.es: Durante el cumpleaños de su marido, Sandra pasa el día con la familia de él. A medida que la hostilidad aumenta, le cuesta distinguir lo que sucede de lo que imagina.
sinopsis.en: Sandra is an overly sensitive young woman who, when under pressure, has trouble with deciphering the line between reality and her twisted fantasies. During her husband's birthday party, she has to spend a day with his family. Their barely concealed hostility is making her gradually lose her mind.
